```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made it nullable because existing rows have no phone value. A `NOT NULL` column would need a default.

`0007` has a typo: the column is `emial` instead of `email`. Fixing it would also need its own migration, e.g. `0009_fix_customers_email.sql` with a `RENAME COLUMN`. I haven't touched it.
